name: tmux
description: Tmux utilities for dispatching tasks to agents in other panes through shared channel documents and reporting results back.

interface.shortDescription: Dispatch tasks to agents in other tmux panes via channel documents and report back.
interface.longDescription: Utilities for inter-pane agent collaboration in tmux: write the task to a channel document under docs/tmux-channel/, send the other pane only that document's path with a reply channel stamped into the message, and report results back by appending them to the same document.
defaultPrompt: Use tmux:tmux-dispatch to hand this task to the agent in tmux pane %7 through a docs/tmux-channel document.
Use tmux:tmux-reply to append the result to the channel document and report back to the pane that dispatched this task.
